reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a turn timeline, hover previews, keyboard navigation, local search, and optional loading of earlier conversation history.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加对话轮次时间线导航、预览、键盘跳转和当前浏览器内的会话搜索。
summaries.en: Adds a conversation-turn timeline with previews, keyboard navigation, and local search to DeepSeek Harness Web.

capabilities: Adds a conversation turn timeline navigation panel to the chat interface
Reads loaded conversation turns locally to provide previews and keyword search
Invokes the host application's native history pagination to load earlier turns
Stores plugin preferences in the host application's settings
